name: Push
description: wisp.push: the push transport for wisp.channels (phones paired by their own keys, notes sealed with HPKE, posted through the grid relay)

commands.title: Pair this phone for notifications: its relay handle and its own public key
commands.uiOnly: the phone pairs itself with the key it just made in its Keystore or Keychain; no harness has a device to pair

commands.title: Stop sending notifications to a paired phone
commands.uiOnly: a phone unpairs itself from its app, or the person does from Settings; an agent never removes someone's phone

commands.title: The phones that get this wisp's notifications
A choice or a reply from a notification, signed by this wisp
commands.uiOnly: only the phone's notification sends it: a tap carries this wisp's signature, which no harness holds
